protocol.timed: complete original/candidate sunlight update incl stack initialization

protocol.gate: 96x96,256x384,736x304 gas/mixed each >=10% median time reduction; vacuum/blocked/override/split each <=3% regression;17x19 reported without timing gate

adaptations: return Ok(false) becomes None to isolate preparation; formatting-only whitespace and optional trailing commas are normalized
original output-vector allocation and GPU species/conductivity construction are appended before returning the staged data
the first-fix baseline already includes correct CPU energy/velocity preparation for small regions
baseline_oracle.shared_helpers: The oracle calls unchanged density-gradient and stencil-union kernels. Its dense stencil isolation wrapper now delegates to the same loop with a fresh mask Vec; no retained mask capacity is shared with the baseline. The nine active GPU cases use either <=2-channel early-return isolation or the unchanged sparse stencil kernel.

protocol.scope: Host preparation plus successful solid-mask transfer/drop only; no GPU submission/readback, Grid projection, Unity/Harmony, complete dispatch, or FPS
protocol.excluded_outer_wrapper: GpuSimulation gas_staging mem::take/restore is outside the measured helper
protocol.lifecycle: With an available device, reuse GasStaging but take/drop solid after every successful prepare; unsuccessful prepares retain scratch. Device-disabled controls create/drop scratch on each call.
protocol.order: ABBA for even blocks; BAAB for odd blocks
protocol.units: nanoseconds per prepare (sample mean of repeated calls)
protocol.p95: Type-7 interpolated quantile of sample means; not a frame-latency percentile
protocol.acceptance: Each 736x304 active 2/4/16-species case needs >=5% median improvement; every other active/control case may regress at most3%. All input comparisons must be bitwise equal.
protocol.sample_policy: All samples retained. No outlier trimming or best-run selection. Compilation and other timing were serialized.

retained_storage.basis: sum(Vec.capacity()*size_of(T)) after the successful solid mask has moved to the caller; not RSS or allocated-byte instrumentation
retained_storage.lifetime: Owned by one GpuSimulation and dropped with it; no global or thread-local cache
retained_storage.limits: Fresh cases cover dense2 and sparse4/16 at736x304. Cumulative cases visit dense2 then sparse4 then sparse16; other dimensions/channel histories can retain different capacity. One transferred mask allocation remains per successful call.
